author: raidensakura
description: Generates a welcome image for new members using Pillow, featuring their avatar, username, join date, and roles. Supports multiple selectable card themes, and includes a command to view any member's card on demand.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store any personal data about individual users beyond their chosen card theme preference. It also stores per-server settings (whether welcome cards are enabled and which channel to post them in).
install_msg: Thanks for installing. Welcome cards are off by default: use `[p]membercard toggle` or `/membercard toggle` to enable them and `[p]membercard channel` to pick a channel. Use `[p]membercard theme` or `/membercard theme` to choose a card theme from an interactive preview, and `[p]membercard testwelcome` (owner only) to preview the welcome message.
name: MemberCard
short: Sends an ID-card style welcome image when members join.
